findings.evidenceJa: 私たちでは考えられない
findings.governingReading: 私たち frames inability to imagine the resistance collectively.
findings.explanation: A group comparison becomes only Caster’s personal imagination.

findings.highlight: her pride are keeping her at bay.
findings.evidenceJa: 誇りが彼女を保たせていた
findings.governingReading: 誇りが彼女を保たせていた keeps her holding on despite fading reason.
findings.explanation: Pride sustains Saber but English keeps her at bay.

findings.highlight: I can keep her under my control without your help
findings.evidenceJa: マスターに力を借りずとも手駒はあります
findings.governingReading: Caster says she has pieces available without borrowing Kuzuki's strength, answering his offer to guard her until Saber becomes usable.
findings.explanation: Caster's assurance that she has other resources becomes an assurance that she can control Saber, changing her stated reason for declining Kuzuki's protection.
